name: repo_review_mode
description: aegis-za4f.17.1: review mode of one repository (aegis:reviewMode on aegis:GitRepo: non-author or none). Param repo = 'owner/name' or a label; matched by exact rdfs:label or skos:altLabel against the whole value or its name part. Returns EVERY matching row: the caller treats no rows or conflicting rows as non-author. 64 rows is an overflow sentinel.

params.name: repo
params.description: Repository as 'owner/name' (e.g. 'intigraph/quipu') or an exact label.
